basic_info.description: Don’t miss this charming 3-bedroom, 2-bath single-family home in the desirable Portola District! The upstairs features 2 spacious bedrooms, 1-bathroom, fresh paint, a newly installed chandelier, and SPC flooring throughout. The updated kitchen includes a newly added pantry. Downstairs offers 1 bedroom with full bathroom. Huge downstairs garage space with potential to add AUD or in-law unit.  The property includes garage, a wide driveway with ample parking, and a concrete backyard with fruit trees—perfect for outdoor living. Located in a quiet neighborhood with convenient access to amenities. A must-see!
